decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works' and shall not exceed 1.5m crown reduction. Every effort shall be made to ensure the retention of as much leaf bearing material as possible. Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 14 (2) 1969: T1 Oak - Crown reduce by removing up to 1.5m all round, and crown lift to create 4m clearance between the ground and the lowest remaining foliage.
